name: What kind of drywall is used in mobile homes?

mainEntity.name: What kind of drywall is used in mobile homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobile homes typically use thinner drywall panels compared to traditional stick-built homes, often 3/8-inch thick rather than 1/2-inch or 5/8-inch. They may also use specialized panels, sometimes called 'v-groove' or 'paneling board,' which often have decorative finishes or are designed for easier installation in manufactured housing. Understanding the specific type and thickness is crucial for effective repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobile homes often use thinner 3/8-inch drywall or specialized v-groove panels, differing from standard residential drywall.
